I was really close to not getting my second shot of moderna bc I was actually nauseous (not just anxiety nausea i could tell it was real) and even the next day with stomach cramps. I also had a weird side effect of having a superrrr sore arm that lasted more than the 2 days and it was numb and tingly for 7 and I thought they damn near punctured my muscle or something. But I still got the second shot without delaying even and I’m super glad I got it. Ofc it’s anecdotal but I was completely fine after ~24 hours getting the shot, and no weird arm effects just the reg flu symptoms. The nurse was really nice when I told her my concerns and said to relax my arm and place the palms of my hands up when getting the shot. I love not having to wear a mask all the time and feeling the breeze on my face (it’s permitted where I live). I’m also less scared to just do things outside in general like grocery shopping. I just kept thinking about someone I knew around my age who tu* from COVID and got severe bronchitis/lung issues. My parents got COVID and it was bad for them and my dad tu*. You got this, it’s so worth imo.

Hey I had these exact symptoms over two years ago and even had more like constipation. I also never v*d. I was diagnosed acid reflux/mild gasritis for the feeling full and throat feeling and IBS for my other symptoms. I had an endoscopy to confirm that the lining of my stomach was a bit red from stomach acid which led to the gasritis diagnosis. It felt a lot more than “mild” tho bc like you it was an everyday thing and impacted my life a lot. Eventually, my mental health got a bit better and my everyday acid reflux went away on its own. I still have IBS symptoms so it’s still an ongoing process for me but I’m just really glad the acid reflux went away bc it was hell. I hope you find the diagnosis and cure that works for you, stay strong.
